Description: To improve data accessibility and usability, EAC Results Summary, Buy Orders and Results by Unit will be archived annually by financial year, while Sell Orders will continue to be archived monthly due to data size. From 15 April 2026, all EAC data (https://www.neso.energy/data-portal/eac-auction-results) before 1 April 2026 will be removed from the live datasets and moved to archives. Existing multi‑year archives will be split into one archive per financial year. This change will make data access faster, more stable, and easier to use. For more information please visit https://www.neso.energy/industry-information/balancing-services/enduring-auction-capability-eac (EAC Releases section).

To improve data accessibility and usability, the NESO Response Reserve Sell Orders FY2023–FY2024 (Archive) dataset (https://www.neso.energy/data-portal/eac-auction-results) will be restructured into monthly files on Tuesday, 3 March. This change will make data access faster, more stable, and easier to use. For more information please visit https://www.neso.energy/industry-information/balancing-services/enduring-auction-capability-eac (EAC Releases section).

The EAC PRODUCTION environment will be unavailable from 7:00 AM to 8:00 AM on 27th November 2025 as we implement CIAM URL updates. From 8:00 AM, the following CIAM endpoints will switch to: 1) OpenID Configuration: https://signin.neso.energy/as/.well-known/openid-configuration. 2) Authorisation Endpoint:  https://signin.neso.energy/as/authorize. 3) Token Endpoint: https://signin.neso.energy/as/token. 4) Token Introspection: https://signin.neso.energy/as/introspect. 5) Token Revocation: https://signin.neso.energy/as/revoke. 6) User Info Endpoint: https://signin.neso.energy/as/userinfo. 7) Signoff Endpoint: https://signin.neso.energy/as/signoff. The EAC Production UI and EAC GraphQL API Endpoint will remain unchanged: https://eac.neso.production.n-side.com/marketparticipant, https://eac.neso.production.n-side.com/market-participant/api/graphql. For more information please see EAC webpage (please go to EAC Releases section): https://www.neso.energy/industry-information/balancing-services/enduring-auction-capability-eac
Notes: This is an enduring change for the EAC PRODUCTION environment.
